def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])

    period=next(p for p in range(1,h+w+1) if all((s%p)!=(t%p) or a==b for s,a in marks.items() for t,b in marks.items()))
    palette={s%period:v for s,v in marks.items()}
    for x in range(period):
        if x not in palette:
            near=min(palette,key=lambda q:(min((x-q)%period,(q-x)%period),q))
            palette[x]=palette[near]
    out=[[palette[(r+c)%period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    assert all(len(row)==w for row in out)
    return out
